sections.explanation: np.exp evaluates e to a power; np.log is natural logarithm. semilogy changes only the vertical scale; loglog changes both. Positive values are required on logarithmic axes. A straight-looking plot is not proof of a physical mechanism. Before accepting a suggested refactor, specify input meaning, domain, expected outputs and boundary tests. sections.code:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
t = np.array([0, 3, 6, 9])
fraction = 2.0 ** (-t / 3)
plt.semilogy(t, fraction, "o-")
plt.xlabel("Time / s")
plt.ylabel("N / N0 (dimensionless)")
plt.show()
print(-3 * np.log(0.1) / np.log(2))
